name: Waiting on your answer, in the brief

aliases: waiting on your answer in the brief

keeps the emails you said need no answer in your own settings
touches.remove: Turn the switch answer_waiting off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone and the route refuses; to remove it for good revert night 37's commit for it (rouh/answer_waiting.py, the brief_answer_waiting route and its lines in rouh/web/brief.py and rouh/project/urls.py, drawAnswerWaiting and its helpers in briefpage.js, this manifest) and delete the user setting answer_waiting. rouh/to_answer.py, which reads the mail, stays: it is Waiting on your answer's own.
